Contract: trace.py CLI: --strict-integrity exits 1 on a duplicate/malformed id or mis-columned row; --strict adds orphan + IF/PB back-link findings; --require-verified adds the G3 status check; writes docs/test/report.md
check_docs.py CLI: --stale exits 1 on a broken intra-repo link, a missing PROJECT-VISION tag, or a generated doc newer than a doc that links it
check_flows.py CLI: --no-placeholders; exits 1 when an authored runtime-flow diagram violates its structural contract or cites an unknown id
check_perf.py CLI: --tier T exits nonzero when a measured metric regresses beyond its declared PB budget tolerance at the block level
check_privacy.py CLI: --repo scans the tree and exits 1 on a secret (always-on floor) or, under docs/privacy-check, a gated identity/PII class
check_stubs.py CLI: --strict exits 1 on a stub/NotImplemented/pass-only public symbol at the declared gate; clean source exits 0
check_dupes.py CLI: --min-tokens N exits 1 on a duplicated significant-token window whose POSIX file pair is not recorded in docs/dupes-allow
check_doc_refs.py CLI: --strict exits 1 on a dangling backticked repo path or a sym:<module>.<name> absent from the arch-map; warn-first (exit 0) otherwise
check_trajectory.py CLI: exits 1 on a WI id/predecessor/cycle or an R-A coherence violation (every run), R-B..R-E under --strict; connectivity coverage is warn-only
gen_arch_map.py CLI: --check exits 1 when the committed MODULE MAP block in docs/architecture.md has drifted from the source tree
gen_trajectory.py CLI: --check exits 1 when root PROJECT_STATE.html is stale or missing (the git as-of line is excluded from the byte compare)
gen_okf.py CLI: --check exits 1 when the docs/okf bundle is stale, missing, or carries an extra file; docs/okf-export off silences it
check.py CLI: --gate G1|G2|G3|all with --tier/--coverage/--lenient runs the active gate's steps as subprocesses and exits nonzero on any required failure (never a silent pass)
bootstrap.py CLI: --dest DIR [--stack/--domain/--agents/--force] writes the mapped kit files so the scaffold harness runs green; idempotent without --force; stamps docs/kit-version
agent_loop.py CLI: --root . resumes from docs/status.md headless (stdin closed), ends each session in a typed outcome code, and refuses a broken footing or a second coordinator
check_vendored.py CLI: network-gated and warn-first; reports a vendored doc copy that has drifted from its recorded upstream source
gen_cases.py CLI: --spec 'name=range[..]|set{..}|bool ; @full|@pairwise|@boundaries' prints the expanded dimensional case set to stdout
gen_release_checklist.py CLI: emits the release-gate checklist (each warn-tier PB id + allocation) from the registries to docs/release-checklist.md
gen_skills_index.py CLI: regenerates skills/INDEX.csv from each SKILL.md applicability frontmatter (generated, never hand-maintained)
subagent_gate.py PreToolUse contract: reads the tool-call JSON on stdin and emits a permissionDecision (deny -> exit 2) per docs/subagent-gate; fails open on any error
reads the SN/SR/LLR/TC spine plus the off-spine PB/REPO/PART/ASSET/CMP/IF registries under docs/requirements + docs/test and joins them by id
reads the declared toolchain (format/lint/test commands, tiers, coverage, arch-map mode, extra [step:*] gates) and docs/gate for the active gate
reads the WI registry (ids/predecessors/status/Deliverable/SpecRef) and cross-reads docs/status.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/stack.ini and interfaces.csv for the SSOT + connectivity coverage
reads work-items.csv for the roadmap DAG and docs/architecture.md's generated MODULE MAP block for the How-SW module/graph view
walks the Python source tree (AST) for the symbol map + internal-import diagram and reads interfaces.csv to merge the IF-### seam edges
parses each *.py under the declared src root (AST) for stub-bodied public symbols at the gate
tokenizes each source file (stdlib tokenize) and slides the --min-tokens window across the set; reads docs/dupes-allow
reads the generated MODULE MAP block as the symbol oracle and scans root + docs/*.md for dangling path / sym: references
reads the Runtime flows section (mermaid sequence blocks) and the registries to validate the authored flow ids
reads root *.md + docs/**/*.md for the link graph, the PROJECT-VISION tag, the SN inventory, and generated-doc staleness under --stale
reads the PB-### budgets registry and a measured-metrics JSON, comparing each in-tier metric to its budget/baseline
reads the staged diff / commit message / outgoing range via git and docs/privacy-check + docs/secrets-scan for the active leak classes
reads the spine registries and the present process docs to emit the docs/okf typed-concept bundle
reads the SN core-needs table and the PB budgets registry to build the release checklist
reads each <skill>/SKILL.md applicability frontmatter (name/scope/stacks/domains/phases/tags)
reads the UPSTREAM manifest and fetches each declared upstream source over the network (network-gated), comparing bytes
reads the next action from docs/status.md (forward-only surface) plus docs/gate, docs/run-state and docs/*-policy via the shared declared-line parse
reads the docs/subagent-gate policy (off|ask|deny) via the shared declared-line parse and honours the SUBAGENT_GATE launcher override
reads the kit template tree (registries, skills, docs, hooks) and the target repo's existing files (idempotent skip) to write the scaffold
the pre-commit floor runs check.py --run-step arch-map/trajectory-map/okf to block a commit that staled a generated artifact (the freshness floor)
invokes the configured agent CLI headless (build_argv substitutes {model}/{prompt}, never through a shell) per run-phase and captures the typed session outcome
the pre-commit floor runs trace.py --strict-integrity on staged content and blocks the commit on any duplicate/malformed id or mis-columned row
the pre-push hook runs check_privacy.py --range over the outgoing commit range and blocks a push that would publish a secret or a gated identity

agent_route.py module/CLI: load_registry/load_enabled + select(pool,tier)->routed id honoring per-model cooldown, the reviewer heterogeneity preference and tier-up-never-down; escalate()/failure_action() the fixed win-stay/lose-shift policy keyed to docs/gate-policy; --select prints the routed id + reason, --list the enabled pool
reads the docs/agents.csv model registry (Id/Provider/Model/Version/Tier/CmdTemplate) and the ordered docs/agents-enabled enable-list to compose the selectable pool; absent enable-list = routing off

score_reviews.py module/CLI: parse_verdict + substance (anchored precision, actionability, cross-reviewer corroboration, optional confirmed rate; length never positive) + fired_tripwires (non-scored gates) + merge_verdict + record_round; --verdict scores a block and exits 1 when a tripwire fired

reads the docs/reviews/*.md verdict files (log.md block + the VERDICT machine line) and maintains docs/reviews/scoreboard.txt - advisory decayed per-provider tallies + the round history the escalation policy reads

run_menu.py CLI: reads docs/stack.ini [run] and presents a numbered menu (no args) / direct launch by name with exit-code passthrough (run_menu.py <name>) / --list (name<TAB>desc, the agent surface); an absent or empty [run] section prints guidance and exits 1
reads the [run] section (one <name> = <command> line per capability plus an optional <name>.desc) declaring the launch capabilities the run.* launchers present
